column4: environment-gated: needs a PostgreSQL DSN, and ci.yml sets none for this job -- so it skips ONCE here, a single env gate rather than a per-dialect or registeredBackends test. Measured by name with CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES/MYSQL/MSSQL/DB all unset: exactly TestAuditRowsAreScopedToTheirTenant. It RUNS in multi-db-ci.yml, which runs ./plugins/... unfiltered with all three DSNs since the -run MultiBackend filter was dropped there. PostgreSQL-only by nature rather than by omission: row-level security is the mechanism under test and plugin.applyTenantScoping emits nothing on MySQL or SQL Server, so running it elsewhere would assert that an absent policy does not apply. Guards cleat#1278 for auditlog: a tenant-scoped read sees one row of two, the retention sweep named with plugin.AcrossAllTenants reaches both, and recordAudit -- which derives its insert context from context.Background() -- puts its tenant back rather than bypassing. It has to connect as a NON-SUPERUSER, because PostgreSQL lets a superuser and a table owner straight past a policy and every other plugin test in this repo connects as one.
